outcome: Complications (twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome, respiratory distress syndrome, intraventricular hemorrhage)
cohort: 31 monoamniotic twin pregnancies managed at Helsinki University Hospital between 2002 and 2018
finding: The study found that monoamniotic twin pregnancies were associated with a high risk of perinatal and neonatal complications, including twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome, respiratory distress syndrome, and intraventricular hemorrhage, but with close monitoring and elective delivery at 32-34 weeks, the outcome was usually excellent.
mod_finding: All children were delivered by cesarean section.
